chunks: About a man who is in salat (prayer) and sees a snake in front of him: is it permissible for him to reach for it and kill it? He said: "If there is one step between him and it, then let him step and kill it; otherwise, no."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being performed
key_terms.بِحِيَالِهِ: in front of him or directly opposite him

ai.seo_question: Can a person in salat (prayer) step forward to kill a snake during the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning someone in salat (prayer) who encounters a snake nearby. It permits limited movement during prayer to kill the snake if it is only one step away, but does not allow this if it requires more than that.
